patch_basis: Team 5's patch_plan.md applied: BufferedDispatcherAgent in orchestrator.py + cycle_2e log fields in worker.py + 200ms sustained-run gate + tts_total_ms proxy in synthetic_caller_full.py. Env-flag PRISM42_CYCLE_2E_BUFFER gated; default OFF; smoke-confirmed wire-equivalent when OFF. Pre-state: cycle-2d FA patch applied, 4 services healthy, baseline cycle-2d-n30 (n=30, fish_full p95=2822ms, e2e p95=4005ms, llm p95=106ms) committed.
verdict_signature: useful_audio_skipped_filler rose from 6.7% (2/30 baseline) to 20% (2/10 cycle-2e). Threefold rate increase indicates Pipecat-style chunking is shipping early frames that the harness then has to skip as filler-bridge or sub-200ms phoneme glitches. The 'first useful audio' drop is partially attributable to harness skipping, not to real audio shipping earlier.

first_segment_published_after_llm_ms p50 = 14 ms, max = 21 ms. The buffer barely held: the first sentence terminator fired ~10-20 ms after the first LLM delta, on 5/10 sessions. The other 5/10 sessions never emitted (gate did not fire — reply lacked a terminator before EOS, so tail flushed at end-of-stream). This matches Empty-buffer bypass signature in patch_plan.md §5: 'orchestrator did not actually buffer; the _gated() generator fast-pathed through.'

real_win_vs_chunked_mask_paragraph: The headline metric (first_useful_audio_after_speech_ms p95) dropped 630 ms (from 3804 to 3174 ms), but the data shows this is chunked-mask, not real-win. Three signatures fire: (1) useful_audio_skipped_filler rose threefold (6.7% baseline -> 20% cycle-2e); the harness's 200ms-sustained-run gate is rejecting more cycle-2e first-frames as phoneme glitches, which means part of the metric drop is the harness skipping noise and finding a later real frame that happens to land earlier on the wire. (2) first_segment_published_after_llm_ms p50 = 14 ms — the buffer almost never gated (sentence-terminator regex fired on the first delta). On 5/10 sessions the segmenter never fired at all because the LLM reply didn't contain a terminator before EOS. (3) p50 of first_useful_audio is unchanged (3053 -> 3023 ms, -1%); the 16.5% p95 improvement is concentrated on the same sessions where skipped_filler also rose, which is the classic chunked-mask co-occurrence. Conclusion: the cycle-2e patch did not produce a clean real-win on this LLM (Nemotron-nano on vLLM); it introduced metric-honesty ambiguity. Per Team 5's playbook this is FAIL_2E_CHUNKED_MASK and the flag stays OFF.
summary_text: FAIL_2E_CHUNKED_MASK. 10/10 real replies preserved, no audio corruption. Headline metric (first_useful_audio p95) dropped 630ms but two FAIL signatures triggered: (a) useful_audio_skipped_filler rose 3x (2/30 -> 2/10), and (b) first_segment_published_after_llm_ms p50 = 14ms (buffer barely engaged; gate fired on only 5/10 sessions). Watchdog GREEN before, after, and after rollback. Code stays on disk; flag rolled back to OFF (40-cycle2e.conf removed); patch is dormant. Lesson: Pipecat's sentence-buffer pattern doesn't help when (i) the LLM's first sentence is short enough that the terminator fires immediately, leaving nothing to gate, and (ii) some replies lack terminators entirely. Nemotron-nano's PSAP-protocol-constrained 5-12-word replies are too short for the buffer to add value; FA streaming + Fish single-chunk render is already the bottleneck.
anomalies: Worker.log shows 5/10 enabled-flag sessions never emitted overlap.first_segment_published_after_llm_ms. Likely cause: LLM reply did not contain '.!?' before EOS — segmenter never fired; tail flushed at end-of-stream via the `if buf.has_content()` path. Verifying this requires inspecting reply text per session, which is not in the harness output. Future cycle should add a `reply_text` capture field to synthetic_caller_full.py for forensics.

first_audio_after_speech_ms p95 also dropped (4005 -> 3506 ms, -12.5%). This is the raw 'first peak>1000 frame after publish_end+0.3s' metric, NOT gated by the 200ms sustained-run check. The drop is consistent with audio actually shipping earlier on some turns; the chunked-mask concern is specifically that sustained-run-gating then skipped some of those frames. Both metrics moved together — partial real signal underneath the chunked-mask noise.
